title: RLinf/RLinf
abstract:
RLinf: Reinforcement Learning Infrastructure for Embodied and Agentic AI

[ ](README.md) [ ](README.zh-CN.md) RLinf: Reinforcement Learning Infrastructure for Embodied and Agentic AI RLinf is a flexible and scalable open-source RL infrastructure designed for Embodied and Agentic AI. The 'inf' in RLinf stands for `Infrastructure`, highlighting its role as a robust backbone for next-generation training. It also stands for `Infinite`, symbolizing the system’s support for open-ended learning, continuous generalization, and limitless possibilities in intelligence development. ## What's NEW! - [2026/08] 🔥 RLinf supports GRPO training for Moonlight-16B-A3B (DeepSeek-V3 MLA + MoE). Doc: [Moonlight-16B GRPO](https://rlinf.readthedocs.io/en/latest/rst_source/examples/agentic/language_models/moonlight.html). - [2026/08] 🔥 RLinf supports MolmoAct2 evaluation on LIBERO. Doc: [MolmoAct2](https://rlinf.readthedocs.io/en/latest/rst_source/examples/embodied/molmoact2.html). - [2026/08] 🎉 Two papers accepted to **OSDI 2026**: [RLinf](https://www.usenix.org/conference/osdi26/presentation/yu-chao) and [DynaRL](https://www.usenix.org/conference/osdi26/presentation/wang-yuanqing). DynaRL dynamically reallocates compute, memory, and communication across heterogeneous RL components to improve end-to-end training throughput. Doc: [DynaRL](https://rlinf.readthedocs.io/en/latest/rst_source/resources/publications/dynarl.html). - [2026/08] 🎉 Two papers accepted to **RSS 2026**: [RLinf-VLA](https://roboticsconference.org/program/papers/89/) and [RLinf-USER](https://roboticsconference.org/program/papers/37/). RLinf-VLA is a unified and efficient framework for scalable RL training of VLA models across diverse architectures, algorithms, and simulators. Doc: [RLinf-VLA](https://rlinf.readthedocs.io/en/latest/rst_source/resources/publications/rlinf_vla.html). RLinf-USER is a unified and extensible system for real-world online policy learning that treats robots as first-class resources alongside GPUs. abstract_zh: RLinf是一个灵活且可扩展的开源强化学习基础设施，专为具身与智能体AI设计。名称中的“inf”代表“Infrastructure”（基础设施），强调其作为下一代训练稳健后端的角色；同时也代表“Infinite”（无限），象征系统对开放式学习、持续泛化以及智能发展无限可能性的支持。最新进展包括：支持GR00T-N1.7、Polaris模拟器、Genesis等平台的强化学习微调；通过系统级优化（精简、按需观测、混合流水线并行），在BEHAVIOR模拟器上实现了端到端加速，将rollout延迟从1028.7毫秒/步降至41.2毫秒/步。
tldr_zh: RLinf是面向具身与智能体AI的开源强化学习基础设施，支持多种平台并实现显著加速。

>[!abstract] 一句话总结：RLinf是一个灵活、可扩展的开源强化学习基础设施，支持多种模型架构（如VLA、MoE）、算法（如GRPO）和仿真器，并提供统一的高效训练框架（RLinf-VLA）与真实世界在线学习系统（RLinf-USER）。


# 一、动机

> 现有的强化学习基础设施难以灵活、可扩展地支持具身智能和智能体AI的训练，无法适应多样化架构、算法和仿真器的需求，需要统一的RL基础设施。


# 二、方法

> RLinf是一个灵活、可扩展的开源强化学习基础设施，支持多种模型架构（如VLA、MoE）、算法（如GRPO）和仿真器，并提供统一的高效训练框架（RLinf-VLA）与真实世界在线学习系统（RLinf-USER）。


# 三、核心实验结果

> RLinf支持160亿参数模型（Moonlight-16B-A3B）的GRPO训练，并在LIBERO基准上评估MolmoAct2；相关论文被OSDI 2026和RSS 2026接收。


# 四、对我的启发

> 该基础设施将机器人视为与GPU同等重要的资源，强调真实世界在线学习和异构资源动态调度，对具身智能的规模化RL训练具有启发意义；具体性能增益和架构细节需进一步阅读论文。
